faq: How much does Synthesia cost?

Basic is free. Starter costs $19/month, or $14/month billed yearly ($168/year). Pro starts at $89/month, or $59/month billed yearly ($708/year), for 6,000 credits a month and goes up to $676/month ($448/month yearly) for 48,000. Enterprise is custom.
Is Synthesia free?
Yes. The Basic plan is $0 with 500 credits and 10 minutes of video a month. Videos carry a Synthesia watermark.
How many credits does a minute of video use?

Synthesia counts the avatar footage generated, not the length of the finished video. A typical finished minute uses about 100 credits, more if the avatar is on screen throughout. Dubbing uses 80 credits per minute with lip-sync and 40 without.
Is there a first-month discount?

On monthly billing, Starter's first month is $9 (then $19/month). Pro's first month is $49 with 6,000 credits a month (then $89/month), $95 with 12,000, $179 with 24,000, $259 with 36,000 and $329 with 48,000.

10 minutes of Studio video creation or dubbing and 3 survey responses. Basic also includes 10 Roleplay sessions a month, 140+ languages and voices, 60+ templates and sharing by link.

No. The credits of {paid} and Pro come on top of the free allowance of the Basic plan.

Credits are one shared pool for all AI usage-based features: video, dubbing, surveys and Syren, {owner} AI video agent.
